images.caption: Figure 1:Reasoning with Temporal Chain of Video Primitives.A text-only keyframe-based prediction focuses on the later hugging event and localizes the wrong athlete. TCoVP progressively records the relevant entities as timestamped video primitives, distinguishes the hand-clasp interval from the longer presence interval, and converts the selected target primitive into a mask trajectory.

Figure 2:Constructing TCoVP supervision.Kimi-K2.5 proposes language traces interleaved with temporally ordered video primitives. Chain-consistency checking and Qwen2.5-VL primitive filtering retain primitives that can be grounded in the sampled video. The filtered examples form TCoVP-SFT-15k and TCoVP-RL-13k.

Figure 3:Chain-aligned training and mask execution.The policy generates multiple serialized TCoVP completions. Structural validity, temporal alignment, spatiotemporal grounding, and target primitive accuracy rewards produce group-normalized advantages, while the reference policy provides KL regularization. The selected target primitives are passed to SAM3 for video mask propagation.

Figure 7:Qualitative comparison with VideoSEG-O3-4B.VideoSEG-O3-4B identifies the relevant shot segment but produces a mask that follows the player rather than the queried basketball. TCoVP-4B explicitly distinguishes the contextual participants from the basketball, grounds the target over the relevant interval, and provides timestamped bounding-box prompts for mask propagation.
Figure 8:Zero-target recognition.TCoVP-3B identifies that the queried turtle is absent from the video, whereas Veason-R1-3B hallucinates the target and produces an erroneous mask trajectory.

Figure 9:Relational and action-based grounding.TCoVP-3B tracks the basketball during the relevant action interval and answers the query correctly, while Veason-R1-3B incorrectly grounds the acting person.

Figure 10:Failure case caused by relational-role confusion.TCoVP-3B correctly identifies and tracks both players but reverses their roles in the query, selecting the man in white instead of the ground-truth target, the man in red.
